data.acceptance:
- `kno pull` and `kno sync` complete while local leases are active, applying
  events for every knot not locally leased.
- Events for a locally leased knot are not applied during the lease, and are
  applied in full once the lease terminates or expires — no event is dropped
  and none is applied twice.
- Quarantine rows survive process restart and are keyed to the base commit at
  which the skip occurred.
- Replayed events land in event-id order; a knot quarantined across several
  pulls converges to the same state as an unfiltered sync of the same events.
- Sync output names the knots that were held back and why.
- Remote-held leases never cause a local skip.
- The MCP background sync loop no longer reports perpetual `sync deferred`
  while agents work.
